name: Wormy
author: Przemysław Bądaruk (Przemekkkth), after Al Sweigart
description: The snake game: eat the apples, grow longer, do not bite yourself or the walls. Swipe to turn; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: The snake game: eat the apples, grow longer, do not bite yourself or the walls. Swipe to turn; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Il gioco del serpente: mangia le mele, diventa più lungo, non morderti e non sbattere contro i muri. Scorri per girare; tastiera: frecce. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
